notes.title: May Update! + RELEASE DATE INFO!
notes.notes:
Hello, good boys and girls!

Oppaidius Desert Island! is essentially completed, but we need few more days in order to fix the last things. It is fully playable from start to finish, but unfortunately the endings/unlocked stuff/achievements system has some weird behavior, so we need to work on it a bit more. I don't want to release a game with bugs on D1, we're trying to make it without issues from 1.0 version already, if possible. Also, this game is HUGE compared to the ones we did in the past, so the 2-3 days working on the last adjustments are just not enough this time around.

We plan to submit the game build to Steam in the next few days, so if they accept it the game will probably be released next week on Tuesday/Wednesday (during the weekend, Steam review system of course is not updated). If Steam "bounces" us off, we need to add at least 2/3 days more. Crossing fingers...

I'm sorry for that (I probably underestimated the final adjustments time required, I expected it to be way less than a week, but it wasn't enough), but let me tell you, I'm really happy with the final result! The game is almost 100% like I imagined it in my mind years ago, and I hope you guys will be happy too, to play it and to read your names in the ending credits.

notes.title: July update + Panic Button preview!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Summer Beta is almost ready. In few days from now we should receive the full English/Japanese translations, and in the next week we should be ready for the release.

Today, I'd like to share a preview of the panic button minigame, we're working on at the moment. After trying some minigames model, we went for something very immediate and fun. Perfect for a panic button! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960903/7597f3f4e1ef1d5e31c97b6a6cd3ada55fd97936.jpg
Only old fellas like me will recognize the original poker game this title screen homages...

It is a classic Poker Ladies-like kind of poker game, where you aim for points (from "Jacks or Better" and up) in order to reach the goal and beat the girl of that stage. As you can see from this preview video, the first "girl" is Jimmy ;)
There will be a total of 3 stages to beat.
The final version of the game, of course, will feature a real chiptuned Game Boy music (as well as sound effects), in the genuine retro-Oppaidius style :) 

https://youtu.be/Kn8KU_34opo

You will access it either by pressing "P" button on your keyboard, or by clicking the "P" icon in the upper right corner.

Thank you very much, as always.

Vittorio and the team

notes.title: March update + Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Oppaidius' April internal build is ready, it has been sent to top backers few minutes ago.

I have an announcement today. As you know, Oppaidius has an awesome soundtrack, made by the talented Luca Della Regina and 3 great japanese guest musicians.

The full game will have TWO more japanese guest musicians, not announced during crowdfunding campaign. Please note-the whole Kickstarter budget is already pretty much “reserved”, so those 2 new musicians are a “gift” from your naughty friends at SbargiSoft :)

The first one is Hideki Higuchi. Oppaidius is a love letter to japanese videogames, especially visual novels… so having a musician like him on board is such an honor. He worked on many visual novels and eroges, both on PC and consoles (Popotan, Elysion, Clannad, etc…), and he produced for us an arranged track so beautiful I almost cried the first time I listened to it :)

Here’s his comment: 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960903/41adc8ea2ce8e854910cdbdf5e54168e29f1bd03.jpg

Thank you very much, as always.

Vittorio and the team
